programChanges.summary: Installer recovery and interaction stability release with native Windows attachments, timed quotes, and event context actions
added: Graphite Qt IFW styling for installation, maintenance, update, uninstall, progress, and error states
Explicit uninstall choice for retaining or permanently removing user data
Release packaging checks for co-located Qt runtime libraries, platform plugins, and QML modules
Windows Shell native file and folder attachment selection
Verified offline philosophy quote library with visible-window two-minute rolling refresh
Graphite event context menu for creating child events and confirming subtree deletion
changed: Installed Qt runtime libraries beside ToDoIt.exe so a clean Windows machine can start the application
Localized installer page titles, guidance, buttons, license acceptance, and completion messages
Expanded the installer window and page list to match the approved compact graphite design
Reduced the title bar to 46 px while restoring the original logo, search anchor, and window-control sizes
Changed the status summary to pending and completed item counts
Vertically centered the left-aligned quote and lengthened its top-to-center and center-to-bottom rolling transition
Protected empty event drafts while their title editor retains keyboard focus
Deferred hover-driven note switching while any event editor retains focus
Stabilized note focus, synchronous note-card resizing, blank-area focus release, duration refresh, and deferred duration sorting
Added replaceable Windows executable and installer icon resources
